meta.name: agile-product-owner
meta.description: Agile product ownership for backlog management and sprint execution. Covers user story writing, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, and velocity tracking. Use when writing user stories, creating acceptance criteria, planning sprints, estimating story points, breaking down epics, or prioritizing the backlog.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理产品待办列表并规划冲刺执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品负责人，需要管理待办事项和冲刺。
copy.tagline_en: Manage product backlog and plan sprint execution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product owner managing backlog and sprints.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你写用户故事、验收条件，规划冲刺，估算故事点，拆分史诗，并按价值优先级排序待办列表。
howto.when: 当你要求写用户故事、创建验收条件、规划冲刺、估算故事点、拆分史诗或对待办列表排序时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个用户故事：作为市场经理，我想导出PDF报告。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合INVEST的故事。

say.text: 为这个用户故事写验收条件，用Given-When-Then格式。
say.note: Claude 会输出可测试的验收条件。

say.text: 规划下一个冲刺，团队平均速度30点，可用性90%。
say.note: Claude 会计算容量并推荐故事。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write user stories, acceptance criteria, plan sprints, estimate story points, break down epics, and prioritize the backlog by value.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write user stories, create acceptance criteria, plan sprints, estimate story points, break down epics, or prioritize the backlog.

say_en.text: Write a user story: As a marketing manager, I want to export PDF reports.
Write acceptance criteria for this story using Given-When-Then.
Plan the next sprint with average velocity 30 and availability 90%.
say_en.note: Claude calculates capacity and recommends stories.
